first_party_results.location: fund, proposeResult, dispute, finalize, refundExpired, and _validateTerms
first_party_results.reason: Timestamps enforce funding, scheduled-start, result-submission, dispute, finalization, and refund deadlines. They do not control randomness or select the winner.
The funding entry point intentionally performs explicit terms, signature, ownership, discipline, replay, and state validation before custody.
The first-party pragma is pinned to 0.8.30. Slither reports mixed directives inherited from pinned OpenZeppelin dependencies.
